intro: Executor Zygand in Brill coordinates the Forsaken campaign against the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades. Using intelligence recovered by Executor Arren, you are dispatched to eliminate Scarlet Warriors stationed at a guard tower west of the Solliden Farmstead. This assault marks the Forsaken military's opening offensive to purge the zealous crusaders from their borders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The documents Executor Arren provided are just the break we needed in our battle with the wretched Scarlet Crusade. We now know their exact locations throughout Tirisfal Glades.
But the Deathguard has larger concerns. The Lich King's army grows in number each night. We need someone with "initiative" like yourself to drive the Scarlet Crusade to the grave.
Prove to me you are capable of serving The Dark Lady by travelling west to the tower past the Solliden Farmstead and slay 10 Scarlet Warriors.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you wish to prove your worth to The Dark Lady, slay 10 Scarlet Warriors, adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Most excellent, adventurer. Your skill in the art of combat is undeniable.
